verdicts.reason: The page is the consolidated Bundes-Krisensicherheitsgesetz; § 6 (headed 'Bundeslagezentrum') contains the quote verbatim and establishes a permanent Bundeslagezentrum in the Interior Ministry for the federal government, reachable in a crisis. That supports the printed name for the federal crisis-management system; note it is a situation centre (a facility), which the source does not describe as a

§ 31a(1) ASVG, quoted verbatim, obliges 'der Dachverband' to introduce ELSY across the whole social-insurance enforcement area and 'dessen Betrieb sicherzustellen' (ensure its operation), which supports the Dachverband as operator. The page itself says only 'Dachverband'; the parenthetical 'der Sozialversicherungsträger' is the ASVG body's full name (§ 31 ASVG) and is printed as an expansion, not

§ 31a ASVG (section headed 'Grundlagen des Elektronischen Verwaltungssystems (ELSY)') contains the quote verbatim and names the 'elektronisches Verwaltungssystem (im folgenden ELSY genannt)'. The same paragraph treats the e-card as a component of ELSY ('Bestandteilen des ELSY durch Speichern und Auslesen von personenbezogenen Daten der e-card'), so the gloss 'the e-card system' is also on the page

§ 10(1) APG (section 'Pensionskonto – Kontoführung'), quoted verbatim, obliges 'Der Dachverband der Sozialversicherungsträger (§ 31 ASVG)' to set up a pension account for every person in scope, and the section governs account keeping; that supports the Dachverband as the body operating the pension account. 'Austrian' in the English gloss is translation context, not a value the source contradicts.

§ 10 APG sits under 'ABSCHNITT 3 Pensionskonto' and the verbatim quote names 'ein Pensionskonto' set up for every person within the act's scope, which matches the printed register name 'Pensionskonto (pension account)'.
